questions.question: Your friend accidentally touches a hot iron and cries out in pain. What is the BEST immediate action you can suggest to an adult?

options.text: Put ice directly on the burn.
options.explanation: Ice can cause further damage to the skin.

options.text: Rub oil on the burn.
options.explanation: Oil can trap heat and worsen the burn.

options.text: Pour cool (not cold) running water over the burn for several minutes.
options.explanation: This is the safest and most effective way to treat a burn.

options.text: Cover the burn with a thick blanket.
options.explanation: Covering can trap heat and worsen the injury.

questions.explanation: For a burn, the immediate best first aid is to cool the affected area under cool running water for several minutes to reduce the pain and prevent the burn from worsening. Ice can be too harsh, and oil can trap heat.
